fix_subject: When the result of a subquery is to be stored in a register and that subquery has an ORDER BY clause and an OFFSET, NULL out the destination register before starting the ORDER BY so that the register will be set correctly even if the OFFSET is larger than the number of output rows. Fix for the problem reported in [forum:/forumpost/0ec80f12d02acb3f|forum post 0ec80f12d02acb3f].
